name: Beginnings
intention: January asks for a gentle start. Choose one small habit to carry with you, and let it grow at its own pace.

name: Kindness
intention: February turns toward the people around us. Notice the small kindnesses you give and receive each day.

name: Growth
intention: March is for noticing change. Look for the places where you are already growing, even slowly.

name: Curiosity
intention: April invites questions. Follow one thing this month simply because it interests you.

name: Bloom
intention: May celebrates what has opened up. Let yourself enjoy the progress you've made without rushing on.

name: Light
intention: June has the longest days. Spend some of that light on what makes you feel most like yourself.

name: Rest
intention: July reminds us that rest is part of the work. Make room for pauses without needing to earn them.

name: Abundance
intention: August is full. Notice what you already have plenty of, and where you could share it.

name: Renewal
intention: September asks us to shed what no longer fits and make quiet room for what's next. Notice where you feel ready to begin again.

name: Harvest
intention: October is for gathering what the year has grown so far. Notice what you've tended, and what is ready to be let go.

name: Gratitude
intention: November slows down to say thank you. Write to, or about, someone who has shaped your year.

name: Reflection
intention: December looks back over the whole year together. Read some old entries and notice how far you've come.
